; margin-todos: loads the to-do tab and panel into the writing screen (firmware 3.22).
; The UI itself lives in /home/root/todo/TodoPanel.qml so it can change without touching this diff.
AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DocumentView.qml
    TRAVERSE FocusScope > Item#_uiContainer
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            Loader {
                id: marginTodosLoader
                anchors.fill: parent
                z: 1000
                source: "file:///home/root/todo/TodoPanel.qml"
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
